vendor.blurb: Opus 5.5 sweeps Text and Code Arena; Fable/Mythos on top. Best for coding and agents.

claude-opus-5-5.tagline: Fable-class smarts, Opus price cut by 40%
highlights: Debuts #1 on LMArena Text Arena at 1509; Anthropic takes the top six
#1 on Code Arena WebDev at 1818, 26 points ahead of GPT-6 Astra
#1 on AA Intelligence Index at 58, 5 points above Fable 5.1 / GPT-6 Astra
Anthropic says typical workloads cost 40% less than Opus 5, output 30%+ faster
claude-opus-5-5.notes: Effort levels low/medium (default)/high/xhigh/max, merged here; Fast mode $8/$40. Still rated behind Astra on writing, and some developers think it trails Fable 5.1 on hardcore coding.

bench.Agent Arena: #2, behind only Fable 5.1 Max; median cost $1.31 per task

claude-sonnet-5-5.tagline: Half the price of Opus, two points behind
highlights: AA Intelligence Index 56, #2 behind only Opus 5.5 and above GPT-6 Astra
Official Terminal-Bench 4.0 70.6%, beating Opus 5.5's 66.4%
GDPval-AA 1844 / OSWorld 2.1 80.1%, roughly level with Opus 5.5
30%+ faster than Sonnet 5 at the same price
claude-sonnet-5-5.notes: Five effort levels merged. At max, about 193K output tokens and $7.60 per task, the highest token burn AA measured; AA tested a pre-release build. LMArena rank pending, with a shot at SS.

claude-fable-5-1.tagline: The public version of a Mythos-class brain
highlights: #1 on Agent Arena (Max), net improvement +13.84%
Terminal-Bench 4.0 55.8%, 13.8 points above Fable 5
GDPval-AA v2 1853, HLE (with tools) 65.0%
Anthropic says typical workloads ~25% cheaper than Fable 5, cache reads down 75%
claude-fable-5-1.notes: A Mythos-class tier above Opus. Same model as Mythos 5.1 but with safety classifiers; default effort is high. After Opus 5.5 shipped its value took a hit, and many users moved over.

claude-mythos-5-1.tagline: Fable at full strength, not for sale
highlights: Same model as Fable 5.1, with cyber and bio guardrails relaxed
Terminal-Bench 4.0 60.9%, above Fable 5.1's 55.8%
Project Glasswing members only (AWS, Apple, Microsoft, etc.)
Mythos 5 autonomously discovered ART, a CRISPR-like enzyme system
claude-mythos-5-1.notes: Mythos is the top tier above Opus: Mythos Preview (2026-04-07), then Mythos 5 (06-09, same model as Fable 5), then Mythos 5.1. Invite-only, with no plans for public release.

highlights: Since 9/25, chatter about Fable 5.5 inside Anthropic's Slack has circulated online
On 9/29 World of AI led with a "Fable 5.5 leak"; unconfirmed
Community consensus: Opus 5.5 has caught Fable 5.1, so Fable 5.5 can't be far
claude-fable-5-5.notes: No official information or benchmarks. A separate 9/5 rumor claims a new pretrained model (dubbed Fable 5.2) arrives in early October. The tier is a placeholder, to be re-rated at release.

claude-opus-5.tagline: Last-gen workhorse, near Fable 5 at half price
highlights: Anthropic says it nears Fable 5's frontier level at half the price
AA Intelligence Index 51, Terminal-Bench 4.0 52.3%
Code Arena WebDev 1692 (Max), 126 points behind Opus 5.5
Anthropic says its ARC-AGI 3 score is triple the next-best model's
claude-opus-5.notes: Scores above Fable 5 but reception was lukewarm, with complaints it is hard to work with. Now legacy; Anthropic recommends migrating to Opus 5.5.

highlights: New tier above Opus, the first public Mythos-class capability
Stripe used it to finish a 50M-line code migration in a day
Terminal-Bench 4.0 42.0%, CursorBench 3.2 70.5%
Priced at less than half of Mythos Preview
claude-fable-5.notes: Same model as Mythos 5; Fable adds a refusal classifier. Knowledge cutoff 2026-01. Superseded by Fable 5.1 but still available.

highlights: Launch promo $2/$10 became the standard price; the planned rise to $3/$15 was dropped
AA Intelligence Index about 38 (max), 18 points below Sonnet 5.5
GDPval-AA v2.1 1449, nearly 400 points behind Sonnet 5.5
claude-sonnet-5.notes: AA score is inferred as Sonnet 5.5's 56 minus 18. Superseded by Sonnet 5.5.

claude-opus-4-8.tagline: The Claude 4 finale and the safety fallback
highlights: Last Opus of the Claude 4 series, 1M context, 128K output
Opus 5.5 falls back to Opus 4.8 on cyber-abuse requests
Opus 5 scores more than double its result on Frontier-Bench
claude-opus-4-8.notes: Legacy but still serving; supports Fast mode ($10/$50). Knowledge cutoff 2026-01.

claude-opus-4-6.tagline: Old guard, still #2 on Text Arena
highlights: Still #2 on Text Arena in 2026-09, just 4 points behind Opus 5.5
SWE-bench Verified 80.8%, Terminal-Bench 2.0 65.4%
Developers still miss its easy, smooth collaboration feel
claude-opus-4-6.notes: Strong on chat preference boards, but clearly behind the 5 series on agents and coding. Opus 4.7 (2026-04) and Opus 4.5 (2025-11) of the same generation are still serving and not listed separately.

highlights: SWE-bench Verified 93.9%, Terminal-Bench 2.0 82.0%
CyberGym vulnerability reproduction 83.1%, far above Opus 4.6's 66.6%
Only 12 partners (AWS, Apple, Google, etc.) plus 40+ critical-infrastructure orgs
claude-mythos-preview.notes: Never released publicly; deprecated on 2026-06-09 when Mythos 5 launched. Priced at more than 2x Fable 5, exact figure unverified.

claude-sonnet-4-6.tagline: Old Sonnet workhorse, still all over production
highlights: Mainstream coding model in H1; many platforms still default to it as mid-tier
1M context billed at the standard rate
Actually 50% pricier than Sonnet 5/5.5
claude-sonnet-4-6.notes: Still Active; Anthropic points Sonnet 3.7/4 migrations to it. Sonnet 4.5 (2025-09) of the same generation is not listed separately.

claude-haiku-4-5.tagline: The small one, a year without a refresh
highlights: Fastest Claude on sale; SWE-bench Verified 73.3% at launch
Knowledge cutoff 2025-02, only 200K context and 64K output
At its price point, newer light models like GPT-6 Luna have pulled ahead
claude-haiku-4-5.notes: Retirement no earlier than 2026-10-15; Haiku 5.5 has been announced to succeed it within weeks.

claude-haiku-5-5.tagline: The announced 5.5 small model, on its way
highlights: Both the Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 launch posts promise it "in the coming weeks"
Aimed at high-concurrency, cost-sensitive workloads; succeeds Haiku 4.5
Community guesses it lands around OpenAI DevDay
claude-haiku-5-5.notes: Announced but not released; no specs or benchmarks. The tier is a placeholder.
